_comment: Row-major hold-ground reform on rally. A ROW-MAJOR player infantry block (60 men at 11 files -- five full ranks plus a centred 5-man rear rank -- with file_major_reform false) is staged already routing, with the enemy still a long way off. Staged that way deliberately: a rout that happens IN contact gets pinned by enemy soldier-body pressure and ground down rather than pulling clear, so it shatters instead of rallying -- rout-rally-recover.json and last-unit-rally.json are both that case. Here nothing is inside the rally-contact radius, so its morale climbs back toward the rout baseline and it re-forms where it stands, between ticks 180 and 240 on the 60 Hz state-dump basis. It rallies at tick 200 at nearly its full flee pace, so it first pulls up over about 85 wu (y~545 at the rally to 460.5) with its men braking in step, and its anchor stands at y=460.5 from about tick 300. The men whose slot moves are left out of the anchor coupling until they arrive, so their walk does not drag the anchor back to meet them; with that drag it stood at y=482. The flee turn is a 180 from its spawn facing, so _face_dir's snap-absorb folds _formation_angle to PI and the rally's reform_ranks(hold_ground = true) takes the about-face branch: the depth reflection that re-squares the grid. Under the old raw index-order assignment that relabelled the whole block, so all 60 men walked the block's depth through the oncoming half to reach slots other men were vacating in the same tick. The rally now deals the slots again file by file from the slots the men held (#1765): each man keeps his file and his place in its order, so the 30 men of the five full-depth files keep their slots and the 30 men of the six short files each step one rank (18 wu) forward. Measured from tick 199 to tick 200, 30 slots move 18.0 wu each; on main e81ea9fa the reflection's pairing moved 6 slots 90.0 wu each, the whole depth of the block. A second, safe player unit well out of the rout-shock radius keeps the battle from declaring defeat while the infantry is routing. The router spawns at morale 22 rather than 5: a router now flees at its real flee pace, so the later rally the old staging gave carried the block off this camera and past the far-tier demotion range before it could re-form.
